# pgvector Service

[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `docker.pgvector.service` |
| Source | `09_docker/docker.pgvector.service.yaml` |
| Tags | docker, database |

PostgreSQL with pgvector extension for vector similarity search. Used as the relational
database scaffold for the content graph MVP, providing both structured data storage and
vector search capabilities in a single system.
